message.text: Identifying the outbound webhook delivery function and its protection against internal network addresses.
I'll look for the HTTP notification/webhook delivery path and whatever blocks internal-network destinations.

args.command: grep -rn -i -E "webhook|notify.*http|outbound|ssrf|internal.?network|private.?ip|loopback" --include='*.go' --include='*.md' | grep -v '/proto/gen/' | grep -v '/web/' | grep -v vendor | head -200
